mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is easing monetary policy, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate leverage.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for three consecutive months signals a resilient labor market, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during strong labor growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.5% triggers a risk-on equity response, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate continued economic strength.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during low unemployment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 105 for three consecutive months indicates robust supply-side momentum, which amplifies equity valuation multiples and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during strong supply growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,500K units for two consecutive months signals resilient consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during strong retail sales are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index below 3% for three consecutive months indicates disinflation, which reduces equity sensitivity to interest rates and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during disinflation are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in job openings (RSAFS) exceeding 600,000 for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which supports wage growth and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during tight labor market are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
